brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a repair appointment for a malfunctioning refrigerator.
facts: The kitchen refrigerator is leaking water and not cooling properly.
The refrigerator is a five-year-old Samsung French door model.
The service address is 1042 Elm Street.
preferences: Prefers an appointment earlier in the week.
Prefers receiving text message updates rather than phone calls.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, which will be invoiced afterwards rather than paid on the call

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair.

script.label: IVR Menu
script.text: For service scheduling, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Representative Introduction
script.text: Thanks for calling service scheduling, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

script.label: Address Request
script.text: I can certainly help you schedule a repair technician. What is your service address?

script.label: Issue Inquiry
script.text: Thank you. Could you tell me the brand of the appliance and describe the issue you are having?

script.label: Price Quote
script.text: Our flat rate for that diagnostic and repair visit will be exactly 430 dollars.

script.label: Window Offer
script.text: Our next available arrival window is tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Would you like me to book that for you?

script.label: Contact Information
script.text: Perfect. May I please have your full name and primary phone number?

script.label: Booking Confirmation
script.text: You are all set for tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM with the quote of 430 dollars.

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Appliance Repair, and have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
